description: This Java source file defines a REST API resource for managing working days within the application's organization module. It includes endpoints to retrieve, update, and get a template for working days, utilizing annotations for API documentation and security. It interfaces with services to perform business logic and serialization.

classes.name: WorkingDaysApiResource
classes.description: Rest controller exposing endpoints for working days management, including retrieval, update, and template data for UI assistance.

methods.name: retrieveAll
methods.description: Handles GET requests to fetch current working days data.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update working days settings based on provided JSON input.

methods.name: template
methods.description: Provides a template of working days data for UI form generation or similar purposes.
